status: Official GDR/QFault v2 field definitions were checked for the H53 and K2 work. SLIPRT2023 is defined in mm/year and SLIPRTNUM is its numeric portion; all 1,126 mirrored records matched source names, rates, and senses, and the H53 source audit reports 84,331 clipped segment pieces. what: Kreemer et al. (2000), On the determination of a global strain rate model, Eq. 3
status: Eq. 3 supplies the documented fault-slip tensor summation used by the separate H53 and K2 physical Stage-1 diagnostics. It does not justify interpreting every scalar residual as an unmapped fault; source-component, dip/rake, geodetic-scale, and model limitations remain explicit in the experiment records.
